messages:
maya: FYI weve locked a joint demo with VectorForge for the trade show Thurs 11:00am PT. Format: 12m partner hardware overview, 18m live marketplace + on-device inference demo, 10m audience Q&A. Can we get a tech smoke and swag check Wed 4pm?

tony: Wed 4pm works. I'll own the marketplace provisioning flow and a short-lived demo API key. Need VectorForge's redirect URI and a list of demo device MACs for firewall allowlist.

serena: I'll handle swag. Order is 140 kits (sticker sheet, patch, travel power bank). 50 kits to EU - will need pro-forma for customs, declared value $28/kit. Courier ETA day-of 07:30; onsite pack starts 08:00.

maya: VectorForge redirect URI? Also confirm whether their edge box uses DHCP or static IP for the demo.

vectorforge (via tony): Redirect URI: https://studio.vectorforge.ai/oauth/callback. Devices use DHCP but we can reserve leases; sending MAC list now.

tony: Added redirect URI to staging allowlist. Demo key will be scoped (read-only, 6h TTL) and I'll DM their lead at 10:50am day-of.

serena: Courier-bot: confirm manifest includes customs forms for the 50 EU kits and that tracking numbers will be added by 20:00.

courier-bot: Pickup scheduled Wed 18:00. Manifest and customs docs uploaded to drive. Tracking numbers to be posted by 20:00.

maya: Dry-run Wed 16:00 checklist (20m): join backstage Zoom, OIDC + demo-key smoke, induce hosted -> dedicated fallback, quick slide handoff, final swag manifest check.

tony: Failover smoke command for staging:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \ 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-vector-177999' \ 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-edge","prompt":"preflight","max_tokens":16,"simulate_load":true}'
```

Expect route to hosted then fallback to `redwood-edge-dedicated` when simulate_load:true triggers. Monitor `routing-decisions` and `failover-events`.

devops-bot: Dry-run reminder set for Wed 16:00 (1780000000). I will ping channel 15 minutes before.

maya: Thanks all  please post any last-minute blocks by EOD tomorrow. We'll finalize the runbook after the dry-run.
